applies_to: Stop lamp (category S4, variable intensity control electronics)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and perform photometric measurement. Pass: intensities automatically fall within the steady-intensity requirements of category S3.

text: The rear combination lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s), and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp light sources (LEDs on PCB, round light-source element in reversing compartment)
test_case: Design review and inspection of the sample against the bill of materials: each light source is identified as a UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable source without use restriction, a light source module or a non-replaceable source; pass if no other type is fitted.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the rear combination lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
applies_to: Light source holders / sockets in housing (e.g. reversing lamp light source, if replaceable)
test_case: Physical fitting trial: attempt to insert each replaceable light source in all possible orientations; pass if it can only be fixed in the correct position.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, using the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source prescribed.
applies_to: Light source holders in housing
test_case: Dimensional inspection of the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 holder data sheet using gauges; pass if all characteristics conform.

text: Where a category of LED substitute light source is also prescribed for the rear combination lamp, the light source holder shall also conform to the IEC Publication 60061 holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source.
applies_to: Light source holders in housing (where LED substitute light source category is prescribed)
test_case: Dimensional inspection of the holder against the IEC 60061 holder data sheet for the LED substitute category; pass if all characteristics conform.

text: The rear combination lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
applies_to: LED light sources, PCB electronics, wiring and connector
test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions, assessed at vehicle type level (e.g. per UN R10); pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems is caused.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source module(s) (PCB modules), if used
test_case: Fitting trial in all possible positions and orientations; pass if the module can only be fitted in the designated correct position.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source module(s) and their retention in the housing
test_case: Attempt removal of the module by hand without tools; pass if removal is only possible with tool(s).

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source module(s)
test_case: Inspection and tamper attempt on the module; pass if the module cannot be opened or altered without evident damage.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source module(s) and their interfaces
test_case: Interchangeability trial with UN approved replaceable light sources in the module interface and vice versa, with and without tools; pass if no interchange is possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
applies_to: Replaceable light source modules of rear position, stop and reversing functions within the same housing
test_case: Cross-fitting trial of each module into the other module positions of the same housing, with and without tools; pass if modules with different characteristics cannot be interchanged.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the rear combination lamp shall be met.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source module(s); photometric performance of rear position, stop and reversing lamps
test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code and repeat the photometric measurements of UN R148; pass if all photometric requirements are met.

text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements of the rear combination lamp shall be made under the conditions of paragraph 4.8.1 using the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (all photometric and colorimetric measurements)
test_case: Annex 3 measurement methods; check the test set-up and conditions against paragraph 4.8.1; pass if all measurements follow Annex 3.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
applies_to: LED light sources on PCB(s) of rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Photometric/colorimetric test per Annex 3 with the original LED modules or PCBs fitted in the lamp; pass if no substitute or external sources are used.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
applies_to: Photometric test set-up for all lamp functions
test_case: Inspect the goniophotometer set-up for masking of housing, reflector and surroundings; pass if no stray reflections reach the receiver.

text: Where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one position or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
applies_to: Housing/mounting of the rear combination lamp (all functions)
test_case: Repeat the Annex 3 photometry for each declared mounting position or for the extreme positions of the reference axis field; pass if all positions comply.

text: If not otherwise specified, the luminous intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Photometry with steady (non-flashing) operation of each function; pass if the readings are taken under continuous operation.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
applies_to: Photometric test set-up
test_case: Verify the photometric distance relative to the lamp's apparent size; pass if inverse-square-law conditions are met.

text: In case the results of measurements are challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
applies_to: Photometric receiver / test equipment
test_case: Calculate the receiver aperture from its size and the measuring distance; pass if it is between 10' and 1°.

text: The intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
applies_to: Luminous intensity of all lamp functions
test_case: For a direction that fails, re-measure within ±0.25° of the nominal direction; pass if the requirement is met within that deviation.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (apparent surface on outer lens)
test_case: Determine the apparent surface outline in the reference axis direction from the drawings or by measurement; pass if the limits are defined for each function.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
applies_to: Electrical supply via the connector for all functions
test_case: Supply 13.5 V for a 12 V system (or 6.75 V / 28 V as applicable) at the lamp connector during photometry; pass if the voltage is maintained.

text: In the case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED driver electronics / variable intensity control (if fitted)
test_case: Operate the lamp with the control gear and settings declared by the applicant during photometry; pass if the operation matches the declaration.

text: In the case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
applies_to: LED light sources on PCB(s)
test_case: Operate at the applicant-specified supply conditions during photometry; pass if the operation matches the declaration.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples on the reference axis (HV) shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8 photometry of both samples at HV; pass if intensity ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum for each function.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometric scan of both samples over the visible field; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, outside the reference axis the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, or not less than the intensity value specified in that light distribution figure, for each direction in question.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Measure at each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if each value ≥ the minimum × percentage, or ≥ the specified value.

text: If not otherwise specified, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Measure over the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if all values ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Visual check and intermediate measurements between grid points per Annex 3; pass if the local variation criteria are met.

text: If the applicant requests the additional test, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd, in order to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear required in UN Regulation No. 48.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp (red light), reversing lamp (white light)
test_case: Optional measurement over H 165°–180° outboard and V -2.5° to +5°, optionally including the vehicle body influence; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

text: If a variable intensity control is fitted, it shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
applies_to: Variable intensity control of stop / rear position lamp (if fitted)
test_case: Operate across all control states and measure the intensities; pass if all values are within the paragraph 5 range.

text: If a variable intensity control is fitted, it shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5 for the specific lamp under night-time conditions for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, or under standard conditions (MOR > 2,000 m, clean lens) for other systems.
applies_to: Variable intensity control of stop / rear position lamp (if fitted)
test_case: Measure the intensity in the night-time or standard-condition state; pass if ≤ the paragraph 5 steady maximum.

text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the ratio between the luminous intensities measured with both lamps on simultaneously and with the rear position lamp on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by ±5° V and ±10° H of the light distribution table; where either lamp contains more than one light source and is considered a single lamp, the values shall be obtained with all sources in operation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (reciprocally incorporated)
test_case: Measure grid points within ±5° V / ±10° H with stop + position lamps on, then with the position lamp alone, all sources operating; pass if the ratio is ≥ 5:1 at each point.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp
test_case: Conduct the luminous intensity compliance tests per the Annex 8 procedure; pass if the Annex 8 criteria are met.

text: The colour of the light emitted by each lamp function (rear position, stop and reversing lamp) shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, applying the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp; Outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement per paragraph 4.8 at points within the Annex 3 light distribution grid for each function; chromaticity coordinates within the limits prescribed for the function's colour (red for position/stop, white for reversing).

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the light emitted by each lamp function.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp; Outer lens; Reversing lamp window/insert
test_case: Visual/colorimetric inspection of emitted light outside the Annex 3 grid field for each function; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
applies_to: LED light sources on PCB(s) for rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Colorimetric verification per relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8 with the LED light sources installed in the lamp; chromaticity within prescribed limits.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp (where e.g. LED array and round light-source element of different technologies are combined)
test_case: Supply each light source technology separately (using applicant-provided samples if required) and measure colour per paragraphs 4.8.1 and 4.8.2; each technology individually meets the colour limits.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity requirements of Table 4.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if all Table 4 values for the declared category (R1 or R2) are met on each sample.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R1)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a) at reference axis; pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and is used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R1)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) in all directions; pass if no value exceeds 17 cd (except as permitted for reciprocal incorporation with stop lamp).

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and is marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 8.5∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R1, marked D)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 8.5 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and is used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 42 cd.

text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and is marked "D" (paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.1∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (R2, marked D)
test_case: Photometric measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 21 cd.

text: The rear position lamp (R1 or R2) shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Photometric grid measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (c), Figure A3-I / Table A2-1; pass if each grid point meets the prescribed percentage of the minimum intensity.

text: Within the angles of geometric visibility (paragraph 4.8.3.1 (d)), the rear position lamp (R1 or R2) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Photometric measurement over the full geometric visibility field; pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd in all directions.

text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with stop lamp
test_case: Photometric measurement below 5° down; pass if intensity ≤ 60 cd there and Table 4 maximum is met elsewhere.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Rear position lamp / outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per para. 4.8.3.1; pass if each sample meets all applicable Table 7 values for its category.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S1)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on the reference axis per para. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S1)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement over the light distribution per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 260 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S1, marked D)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 130 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the light distribution shall comply with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S1)
test_case: Measure intensities at the grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the prescribed percentage of the minimum intensity.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 3∙10^-1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S1)
test_case: Measure intensity throughout the geometric visibility field of Table A2-1 per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 730 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 3.65∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2, marked D)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no intensity > 365 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the light distribution shall comply with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2)
test_case: Measure intensities at the grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the prescribed percentage.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 3∙10^-1 cd for day condition.
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2)
test_case: Measure in day mode throughout the Table A2-1 field per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be not less than 7∙10^-2 cd for night condition.
applies_to: Stop lamp (category S2)
test_case: Measure in night mode throughout the Table A2-1 field per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if all values ≥ 0.07 cd.

text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Stop lamp / outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall meet the requirements in Table 10, with the standard light distribution as defined in Figure A3-V.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 at the Figure A3-V grid points; pass if all Table 10 values are met.

text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall emit a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if the minimum luminous intensity is ≥ 80 cd where required.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) over all directions in or above the H-plane; pass if maximum ≤ 300 cd.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) from H-plane down to 5°D; pass if maximum ≤ 600 cd.

text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) below 5°D; pass if maximum ≤ 8,000 cd.

text: If the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: If pair-only approval is applied for: measure luminous intensity at 30° inwards; pass if ≥ 25 cd.

text: If the reversing lamp is approved under the pair-only condition, the device shall only be installed on the vehicle in a pair.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (vehicle installation)
test_case: Inspect vehicle installation against communication form paragraph 9.1.3; pass if reversing lamps are fitted as a pair.

text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (LED light sources / electronics)
test_case: Verify failure behaviour per paragraph 4.6 (e.g. simulated LED failure); pass if paragraph 4.6 requirements are met.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
applies_to: Reversing lamp, reversing lamp window/insert in outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light per colour specification of the regulation; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the white boundaries.

text: The rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions) shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp (all functions)
test_case: CoP check: compare production samples with the approved type documentation and drawings; pass if no deviations from the approved type.

text: The compliance of production lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5. shall be verified according to paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.3.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp (all functions)
test_case: Production verification plan covering Annex 4 CoP procedures, Annex 5 inspector sampling and the photometric deviation limits of paragraph 6.1.3; pass if all are satisfied.

text: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 shall be complied with for the rear combination lamp.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp production
test_case: Audit the manufacturer's CoP control procedures and test records against Annex 4; pass if all minimum requirements are met.

text: The rear combination lamp production shall comply with the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp production
test_case: Inspector sampling and photometric/colorimetric testing per Annex 5; pass if the samples meet the Annex 5 acceptance criteria.

text: For conformity of production, no measured value of the rear position, stop or reversing lamp shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (photometric and colorimetric values)
test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if every measured value is within an unfavourable deviation of 20 per cent of the prescribed value.

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 7∙10-1 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 5∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 3∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (field minimum intensities)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the Annex 2/3 fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 6∙10-1 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 4∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (field minimum intensities)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 4∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 2∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 3∙10-1 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 1∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (field minimum intensities)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 2∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 1∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 7∙10-2 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 5∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (field minimum intensities)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 5∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 3∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, where the required minimum value is 5∙10-2 cd, the measured value shall be not less than 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) or 2∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as per Table 12.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (field minimum intensities)
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement across the fields per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if the measured value is ≥ 3∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) or ≥ 2∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

text: The angles of geometric visibility of Annex 2 are those for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle; the handed rear combination lamp for the opposite (left) side shall meet the same angles in the mirrored arrangement.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (right-hand and mirrored left-hand units)
test_case: Design and drawing review of both handed units against Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the inboard and outboard directions are correctly assigned for each side.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface per Annex 2 Figures A2-I, on drawings or with a goniometer. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is mounted with its H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used, but only below the H-plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Confirm that the installed H-plane height is below 750 mm. Check visibility below the H-plane. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from at least 20° inboard to 80° outboard.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Vertical geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is to be installed with its H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles shall be 15° above / 5° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Confirm that the mounting height is less than 750 mm. Check visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is mounted with its H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used, but only below the H-plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Confirm that the H-plane height is below 750 mm. Check visibility below the H-plane. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from at least 20° inboard to 45° outboard.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Vertical geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Figures A2-I. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

text: If the stop lamp (S1, S2) is to be installed with its H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles shall be 15° above / 5° below the H-plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Confirm that the mounting height is less than 750 mm. Check visibility. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 5° below the H-plane.

text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall have their direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponding to the reference axis, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, oriented in the required direction of visibility and passing through the centre of reference.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp (photometric reference axis / centre of reference)
test_case: Review the drawing and mounting data: the reference axis passes through the declared centre of reference and is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle median longitudinal plane in the installed position. Pass if consistent.

text: Unless specified otherwise, the minimum intensities for the various directions of measurement shall be the percentages shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV of the minimum intensities required, mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp
test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at each grid point. Compute each point limit as the figure percentage times the required minimum intensity, rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured value is at least its limit.

text: Where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the H plane. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid only down to V = -5°. Pass if all points from V = -5° upwards meet their minima.

text: Where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer), the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Check the declared mounting height of the H plane. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify the stop lamp grid only down to V = -5°. Pass if all points from V = -5° upwards meet their minima.

text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown, as a percentage, on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp
test_case: Goniophotometric scan between the grid points. Pass if every intermediate direction is at least the lowest minimum of the surrounding grid points.

text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement shall be below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: First examine the lit lamp visually. If substantial local variations appear, measure the intensity between adjacent grid directions of Figure A3-V. Pass if each value is at least 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (Table 3) according to the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at the Figure A3-I grid points. Pass if each point is at least its percentage of the Table 3 minimum.

text: The stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (Table 7) according to the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at the Figure A3-I grid points. Pass if each point is at least its percentage of the Table 7 minimum.

text: The reversing lamp shall emit, at the measuring points of Figure A3-V (expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference), at least the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Measure on a goniophotometer at each Figure A3-V point relative to the reference axis. Pass if each value in cd is at least the value shown in the figure.

text: The mass-produced rear combination lamp shall conform to the approved type from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: Housing, outer lens, retro-reflector, reflector surfaces, overall lamp geometry
test_case: Dimensional/geometric inspection of production samples against approved drawings; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing tolerances and all Regulation requirements are still met.

text: With respect to photometric performances, any mass-produced lamp chosen at random shall meet the photometric requirements when tested according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp functions
test_case: Photometric measurement of a randomly selected production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if the photometric requirements of the Regulation are met for each function.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the mass-produced lamp shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (red), stop lamp (red), reversing lamp (white), outer lens
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per paragraph 4.9.; pass if the chromaticity coordinates fall within the prescribed colour boundaries for each function.

text: For each type of lamp, the holder of the type approval shall carry out at least the conformity of production tests specified in Annex 4, at appropriate intervals, in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (all functions)
test_case: Audit of the COP test plan and records; pass if tests are defined and performed at appropriate intervals per the Regulation.

text: If any sampling shows non-conformity with regard to the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (all functions)
test_case: Review of COP records for non-conforming samples; pass if additional samples were taken and tested after each non-conformity.

text: The manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production (all functions)
test_case: Review of corrective action records following non-conformities; pass if documented corrective actions restored conformity.

text: Tests of conformity of production shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics of the lamp.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp functions
test_case: Review of the COP test plan; pass if both photometric and colorimetric tests are included for each function.

text: Conformity of production tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
applies_to: COP test procedures for the rear combination lamp
test_case: Comparison of the COP test procedures with the Regulation's methods; pass if they match, or if equivalent methods are approved under P12.

text: If equivalent test methods are used in conformity tests carried out by the manufacturer, they shall be used only with the consent of the competent authority, and the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
applies_to: COP test procedures for the rear combination lamp
test_case: Review of the authority consent and the equivalence/correlation evidence for any alternative method; pass if both are documented.

text: The test apparatus used for conformity tests shall be regularly calibrated and correlated with measurements made by a competent authority.
applies_to: Photometric and colorimetric test equipment
test_case: Review of calibration certificates and correlation records; pass if calibration is current and correlation with authority measurements is demonstrated.

text: Samples of lamps shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch of lamps of the same type, and records from several factories may be grouped only if they operate under the same quality system and quality management.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp production sampling
test_case: Audit of the sampling procedure and records; pass if samples are random from a uniform batch, and any multi-factory grouping is justified by a common quality system and quality management.

text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3 and to measurement of the required chromaticity coordinates.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp functions
test_case: Photometric measurement at all Annex 3 points and colorimetric measurement of each function; pass if minimum values and chromaticity coordinates are met and recorded.

text: The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the competent authority, acceptability criteria to meet the verification of conformity requirements of paragraph 6.1. of this Regulation.
applies_to: COP statistical evaluation for the rear combination lamp
test_case: Review of the statistical study and the agreed acceptability criteria; pass if both are documented and agreed with the authority.

text: The acceptability criteria shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 5 would be 0.95.
applies_to: COP statistical evaluation for the rear combination lamp
test_case: Statistical verification of the acceptance criteria; pass if the probability of passing an Annex 5 spot check is at least 0.95 at a 95 per cent confidence level.

text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes may be calculated from the distribution measured after photometric stability by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (LED light sources)
test_case: Annex 8 para 1.2.1: operate reversing function and measure luminous intensity at 1 min and at 10 min, or measure the full distribution at photometric stability and scale it using HV ratios at 1 min and 10 min. Pass: all test points within the minimum and maximum values at both times.

text: For the rear position lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. The distribution after 1 min may be calculated from the distribution after 30 min or after photometric stabilization by applying at each test point the HV intensity ratio.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (LED light sources)
test_case: Annex 8 para 1.2.2: operate rear position function and measure at 1 min and at 30 min or photometric stability, or scale the full distribution using HV ratios. Pass: all test points within the minimum and maximum values at both times.

text: For the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. The distribution after 1 min may be calculated from the distribution after 30 min or after photometric stabilization by applying at each test point the HV intensity ratio.
applies_to: Stop lamp (LED light sources)
test_case: Annex 8 para 1.2.2: operate stop function and measure at 1 min and at 30 min or photometric stability, or scale the full distribution using HV ratios. Pass: all test points within the minimum and maximum values at both times.

text: If the rear position lamp uses a light generating technology other than LED only or incandescent only (paragraphs 2.1.3 and 2.1.4), the luminous intensity distribution shall comply with the intensity requirements from 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, until photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Annex 8 para 2.1, Table A8-1: measure the HV run-up from switch ON, scale the para 1 distribution by the HV ratio at 4 s and later times. Pass: within min/max from 4 s until photometric stability. Deemed compliant if the function is LED only and para 1.2 is met.

text: If the stop lamp uses a light generating technology other than LED only or incandescent only (paragraphs 2.1.3 and 2.1.4), the luminous intensity distribution shall comply with the intensity requirements from 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, until photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Annex 8 para 2.1, Table A8-1: measure the HV run-up from switch ON, scale the para 1 distribution by the HV ratio at 0.2 s and later times. Pass: within min/max from 0.2 s until photometric stability. Deemed compliant if the function is LED only and para 1.2 is met.

text: If the reversing lamp uses a light generating technology other than LED only or incandescent only (paragraphs 2.1.3 and 2.1.4), the luminous intensity distribution shall comply with the intensity requirements from 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, until photometric stability is reached.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Annex 8 para 2.1, Table A8-1: measure the HV run-up from switch ON, scale the para 1 distribution by the HV ratio at 0.2 s and later times. Pass: within min/max from 0.2 s until photometric stability. Deemed compliant if the function is LED only and para 1.2 is met.

text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or for the approval marking and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens or housing marking area
test_case: Drawing review and sample inspection: confirm a dedicated marking area large enough for the UI (or approval marking) plus the 3.3.4.2 markings at the size required by Table 1.

text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
applies_to: All markings (approval mark/UI, trade name, TOP)
test_case: Visual check at normal reading distance for legibility. Indelibility check, e.g. rubbing with a cloth soaked in water and then in fuel/solvent; markings must remain legible.

text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for "a" defined in Table 1.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Measure the dimensions of the approval mark components against the value of "a" in Table 1. Use the Annex 10 examples as the arrangement reference.

text: The approval marking shall include the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking against the approval documents: the circle with "E" and the correct country number must be present.

text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: the sequential number must match the approval number and have 4 to 6 digits.

text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the layout: the sequential number must be adjacent to the E-circle, as in the Annex 10 examples.

text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
applies_to: Approval marking / retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection: the class symbol(s) of the retro-reflector (e.g. IA or IB) must be present and match the approval.

text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection: "150R" followed by the correct series-of-amendments digits (e.g. 00) must be present.

text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format of Figure I of paragraph 3.3.3.1.
applies_to: Unique Identifier marking
test_case: Visual comparison of the UI mark with Figure I. The UI number must match the entry in the UN secure internet database.

text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / lamp housing or lens
test_case: Visual inspection: the applicant's trade name or mark must be present and legible.

text: If the retro-reflector is of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word "TOP" shall be inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Review the retro-reflector's rotational symmetry and the mounting orientation specified by the manufacturer. If orientation is ambiguous, verify that "TOP" is horizontal at the highest part of the illuminating surface.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / lamp marking location
test_case: Visual inspection of the sample: all required markings must be legible on the device itself.

text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the combined lamp, the marking shall be visible after installation on the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp single approval marking
test_case: Install the lamp in the vehicle or a representative fixture and confirm the single marking is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is used, no part of the combined lamp that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
applies_to: Outer lens, reversing lamp window/insert, retro-reflector and housing
test_case: Design review and disassembly check: each light-transmitting part (outer lens, reversing insert, retro-reflector) must be inseparable from the part carrying the marking.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
applies_to: Single approval marking of the combined lamp
test_case: Measure the mark components and compare them with the minimum sizes required by each applicable Regulation (e.g. R148, R150). Pass if each component is at least the minimum required for the smallest individual mark.

text: The conformity of production procedures for the retro-reflector shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), together with the requirements of paragraph 3.5.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (production / quality system)
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's CoP procedures against 1958 Agreement Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3). Pass: documented procedures are in place and conform.

text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Take production samples and verify them against the requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. (e.g. photometric, colorimetric and resistance tests). Pass: samples meet the requirements and match the approved type.

text: For retro-reflectors, the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (manufacturer production control)
test_case: Review the manufacturer's production control plan, test frequencies and records against Annex 2. Pass: all Annex 2 minimum control procedures are implemented and documented.

text: For retro-reflectors, the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 shall be complied with.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (inspector sampling)
test_case: Have the inspector draw samples and test them according to the Annex 3 sampling scheme. Pass: samples meet the Annex 3 acceptance criteria.

text: The retro-reflector shall meet the requirements contained in section 5 "General specifications" of UN Regulation No. 48, and the Annexes referenced in that section, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, as pertinent to the retro-reflecting device and to vehicle category M1, where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (as installed in the rear combination lamp on M1 vehicles)
test_case: Inspect the device and its installation drawings against UN R48 section 5 and the referenced Annexes for M1. Pass if every pertinent requirement that can be verified at device approval is met.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall meet the individual specifications for this device in section 6 of UN Regulation No. 48, and the Annexes referenced in that section, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval. These specifications cover presence, number, arrangement, position (width, height, length), geometric visibility, orientation and other requirements, as pertinent to vehicle category M1. They apply where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (rear, non-triangular) mounting position and geometric visibility on M1 vehicle
test_case: Check the drawings and the device against the UN R48 section 6 provisions for rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular: mounting height and lateral position, geometric visibility angles and orientation for M1. Pass if all requirements that can be verified at device approval are met.

text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Design review and inspection of samples after the R150 annex tests (e.g. heat, water, dust, corrosion resistance); pass if the retro-reflector still meets photometric and colour requirements.

text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Visual and design inspection of production samples; pass if no defects affecting operation or maintenance are found.

text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens, housing
test_case: Attempt manual disassembly without tools; pass if retro-reflector components cannot be easily separated.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
applies_to: Outer lens / retro-reflector outer surface
test_case: Visual and tactile inspection plus cleaning trial with cloth; pass if surface is easily cleaned.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
applies_to: Outer lens / retro-reflector outer surface
test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if not rough and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens, housing, seal / gasket
test_case: Inspection of the mounted assembly; pass if the inner (reflecting) surface cannot be reached without dismantling the lamp.

text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, it shall be so designed that the optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens
test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt under normal-use conditions; pass if optical unit and filter remain inseparable.

text: The retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens
test_case: Material/process documentation review and visual inspection; pass if colour is obtained from coloured material, not paint or varnish.

text: For testing the colour of the red retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (night-time colour test set-up)
test_case: Colorimetric test per R150 para. 4.2.1.2: check that the set-up uses CIE Standard Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°. If a colourless surface reflection occurs, check that the alternative angle per Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1 is used. Pass: the test conditions are documented as specified.

text: When illuminated as specified in paragraph 4.2.1.2, the trichromatic coordinates of the luminous intensity reflected by the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour (red) of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens (night-time colour of retro-reflected light)
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates x, y of the retro-reflected light under CIE Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1 = β2 = 0° (or the Annex 4 Part 1 para. 1.1 angle). Pass: x, y lie within the red night-time colour boundaries defined in UN R48.

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Visual inspection and measurement against Annex 5 on all ten samples at the start of the Table 4 sequence; pass if shape and dimensions conform to Annex 5.

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if RI values meet Table 3 (red) and colour is within the R48 night-time red limits.

text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens, housing
test_case: Run the Table 4 test sequence (heat, water, fuels, oils, corrosion, rear face, stability in time, weathering); pass if all tests are passed with subsequent colour and RI compliance.

text: After the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6, and at least one hour after this test, the retro-reflector shall meet the colorimetric characteristics of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° (or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.).
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Heat all ten samples 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, wait ≥1 h, measure colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if colour within red limits and RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum RI values after the heat test shall meet the complete photometric requirements of paragraph 5.1.4.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Complete photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 on min and max samples; pass if all Table 3 red values for Class IA/IB are met.

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) followed by the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens, seal/gasket
test_case: First group of two samples: water penetration then motor fuels and oils; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall, if necessary, pass the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and then the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (rear face)
test_case: Second group of two samples: corrosion then rear face abrasion; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and subsequent colour and RI comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the test for stability in time of the optical properties of the retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Third group of two samples per Part 3 of Annex 4; pass if subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall pass the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens
test_case: Fourth group of two samples per Part 6 of Annex 6; pass if subsequent colour and RI (20', β1 = β2 = 0°) comply.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2. (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each test group; pass if within R48 night-time red limits.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each group; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx (red).

text: Where more than one or a range of different axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements with reference to each axis of reference or to the extreme axes of reference of the range specified.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Repeat photometric measurements for each declared axis / extreme axes of the range; pass if Table 3 values are met each time.

text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter shall be considered, and the illuminating surface shall be limited to 100 cm2.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Check the manufacturer-specified perimeter of the measured area lies within a 200 mm diameter circle and does not exceed 100 cm2; perform photometry on that area only.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 200 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 5 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 2.8 mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx.

text: RI values of the red retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last applicable column of Table 3 (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Scan photometry within the bounded solid angle per Part 1 of Annex 4; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx at 20' and ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx at 1°30' throughout.

text: Where the Class IA or IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation height)
test_case: Confirm declared mounting height of H plane; if < 750 mm, verify Table 3 RI values down to 5° below horizontal only.

text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Colorimetric test per paragraph 4.2.1.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens (red area over retro-reflector)
test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if within R48 night-time red limits.

text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C without distortion on visual inspection.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens, housing
test_case: All ten samples, 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C; visual inspection for distortion; pass if no distortion and subsequent colour and RI comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the water test of 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, seal/gasket, outer lens
test_case: Two samples, 10 min normal + 10 min inverted; pass if no water penetration on visual inspection and colour and RI comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall withstand exposure to motor fuels for 5 min (Part 1 of Annex 7) and to oils for 5 min (Part 2 of Annex 7), followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens
test_case: Two samples, 5 min motor fuels then 5 min oils; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and colour and RI comply.

text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours) and the rear face test of 1 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (rear face)
test_case: Two samples, corrosion 24 h + 2 h interval + 24 h, then rear face 1 min; pass if visual inspection satisfactory and colour and RI comply.

text: From a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the differences of mass-produced retro-reflectors from the approved type shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (mechanical and geometric conformity of production)
test_case: Dimensional and visual inspection of random production samples against the approved drawings; pass if deviations stay within normal manufacturing tolerances and the R150 requirements.

text: When the photometric performance of any retro-reflective device chosen at random from mass production is tested, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (photometric performance, CoP)
test_case: Measure the coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL) of randomly chosen production samples at the R150 measurement points; pass if every value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced retro-reflective device shall comply with UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens colour (red)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if the coordinates lie within the prescribed red colour boundaries.

text: For each type of retro-reflective device, the holder of the approval mark shall carry out at least the conformity tests of Annex 2, at appropriate intervals and in accordance with the provisions of UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (manufacturer CoP test programme)
test_case: Audit the CoP plan and test records; pass if the tests are defined, performed at the planned intervals and done to R150 methods.

text: If any sampling shows non-conformity for the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested, and the manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP non-conformity handling)
test_case: Review non-conformity records; pass if each failure was followed by additional sampling and testing and by documented corrective action.

text: The conformity tests shall cover the photometric characteristics of the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (photometry)
test_case: Check that CoP records include photometric measurements per R150.

text: The conformity tests shall cover the colorimetric characteristics of the retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens (colour)
test_case: Check that CoP records include colorimetric measurements per R150.

text: The conformity tests shall cover the resistance of the retro-reflective device to penetration of water.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, housing, seal/gasket, outer lens
test_case: Perform the R150 water penetration test on production samples; pass if the R150 acceptance criteria are met and this is recorded in the CoP records.

text: Conformity tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP test methods)
test_case: Compare the test procedures with the R150 methods; pass if they are the same.

text: Where the manufacturer uses methods equivalent to those of UN R150 in conformity tests, these shall be used only with the consent of the Type Approval Authority, and the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (alternative CoP test methods)
test_case: Review the equivalence evidence and the authority's consent; pass if both are documented for every alternative method.

text: The test apparatus used for conformity tests shall be regularly calibrated and correlated with measurements made by a Type Approval Authority.
applies_to: Photometric, colorimetric and water-penetration test equipment for the retro-reflector
test_case: Review the calibration certificates and correlation records; pass if they are current and the correlation with the authority's measurements is demonstrated.

text: In all cases, the reference methods for conformity testing shall be those of UN R150, particularly for the purpose of administrative verification and sampling.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP reference methods)
test_case: Check that any dispute or administrative verification is resolved using the R150 methods.

text: Samples of retro-reflective devices shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch of devices of the same type, defined according to the production methods of the manufacturer.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP sampling)
test_case: Review the sampling procedure and records; pass if samples are drawn at random from a defined uniform batch of one type.

text: The conformity assessment shall in general cover series production from individual factories; records of the same type from several factories may be grouped only if these factories operate under the same quality system and quality management.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP records by factory)
test_case: Review the CoP records; pass if records are kept per factory, or are grouped only for factories under a common quality system and quality management.

text: The sampled retro-reflective device shall be subjected to photometric measurements at the points provided for in UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (photometry)
test_case: Measure the CIL at all R150-specified observation and entrance angles and record the results.

text: The chromaticity coordinates provided for in UN R150 shall be measured and recorded on the sampled retro-reflective device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (colour)
test_case: Measure and record the chromaticity coordinates per R150.

text: The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results and define, in agreement with the Type Approval Authority, criteria governing the acceptability of the products, so as to meet the specifications in paragraph 3.5.1. of UN R150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP acceptance criteria)
test_case: Review the statistical study and the agreed acceptance criteria documentation.

text: The criteria governing acceptability shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 3 (first sampling) would be 0.95.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP acceptance criteria)
test_case: Statistical evaluation of the production data; pass if the computed probability of passing the Annex 3 first sampling is at least 0.95 at a 95 per cent confidence level.

text: From a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, differences of mass-produced retro-reflectors from the approved type shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Inspector sampling per Annex 3: dimensional and mechanical inspection of randomly chosen production retro-reflectors against the approved type. Pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations.
