text: When the photometric performance of any retro-reflective device chosen at random from production is tested, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (photometric performance)
test_case: Photometric measurement of randomly chosen production retro-reflectors per UN R150. Pass if every measured value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum. Devices with apparent defects are disregarded.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (colour of retro-reflected light)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of randomly sampled production retro-reflectors. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the limits prescribed for the red rear retro-reflector colour.

text: In the first sampling of four randomly selected retro-reflective devices (samples A and B), the photometric deviation of any specimen shall not be more than 20 per cent.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP sampling)
test_case: Annex 3 paragraph 2: photometric test of 4 random production devices. Pass if every specimen deviates by 20 per cent or less. If both devices of sample A deviate by 0 per cent, the measurement can be closed.

text: In the first repeated sampling of four retro-reflective devices manufactured after alignment (samples C and D), the photometric deviation of any specimen shall not be more than 20 per cent, and no specimen shall exceed 30 per cent.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP sampling)
test_case: Annex 3 paragraph 3: photometric test of 4 random devices from post-alignment stock. Pass if every specimen deviates by 20 per cent or less. A deviation above 30 per cent leads to withdrawal of approval.

text: In the second repeated sampling of four retro-reflective devices manufactured after alignment (samples E and F), the photometric deviation of any specimen shall not be more than 20 per cent.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (CoP sampling)
test_case: Annex 3 paragraph 4: photometric test of 4 random devices. Pass if every specimen deviates by 20 per cent or less. Otherwise the approval is withdrawn.

text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A, after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2., shall pass the resistance to water penetration test described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6. If it fails, the two retro-reflective devices of sample B shall both pass the same test.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, outer lens and seal/gasket (water tightness)
test_case: Water penetration test per Annex 6, Part 2, paragraph 1 on one sample A retro-reflector. Pass if the test is passed. On failure, both sample B devices are tested and both must pass.

text: When the RI of the retro-reflector is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 goniophotometer: at β1 = β2 = 0°, slightly turn the device and check for a mirror effect; record the result.

text: If a mirror effect is produced at β1 = β2 = 0°, the RI reading of the retro-reflector shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: If a mirror effect is found, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° instead of 0°/0°; that reading is used for assessment.

text: If the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', it shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (not marked TOP)
test_case: Rotate the device about its reference axis at β = 0°/0° (or the paragraph 5 angle) and α = 20'. Find the minimum-RI position. Pass if this RI ≥ the paragraph 5 value.

text: If the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", when the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, it shall be placed in the position corresponding to the minimum-RI value of ε; if the specified values are not attained, it may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (not marked TOP)
test_case: Measure all other angle combinations at the minimum-RI ε. If any value is not attained, rotate up to ±5° from that ε and re-measure. Pass if the specified values are met.

text: If the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', it shall be rotated about its axis ±5° and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed during this rotation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (marked TOP)
test_case: Rotate the device ±5° about its axis from the TOP position at α = 20' and record RI continuously. Pass if RI ≥ the prescribed value in every position.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0° and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflector exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Measure RI at β = 0°/0° and ε = 0°. If RI ≥ 1.5 × the specified value, perform all remaining measurements at ε = 0°.

text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring the retro-reflector.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Check that the test setup and report use the CIE angular system (α, β1, β2, ε) of Figure A4-I.

text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Verify the source calibration certificate confirms CIE Illuminant A (2856 K).

text: In the measuring geometry for the retro-reflector, the angular diameter of the source shall be δ ≤ 10'.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Calculate δ from the source aperture size and the measuring distance. Pass if δ ≤ 10'.

text: In the measuring geometry for the retro-reflector, the angular diameter of the measuring device shall be γ ≤ 10'.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Calculate γ from the receiver's largest dimension and the measuring distance. Pass if γ ≤ 10'.

text: In the measuring geometry for the retro-reflector, the angular diameter of the illuminated area shall be η ≤ 80'.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Calculate η from the retro-reflector's largest visible dimension and the measuring distance. Pass if η ≤ 80'.

text: The measuring distance shall be chosen so that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Measure the distance between the source/receiver and the reference centre. Pass if it is ≥ 10 m and the δ, γ and η limits are met.

text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflector, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform, with max/min ≤ 1.05, checked with a measuring element whose sensitive area is not greater than one-tenth of the area examined.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Scan the useful area with a detector of ≤ 1/10 of that area. Pass if Emax/Emin ≤ 1.05.

text: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Check the photometer V(λ) calibration certificate.

text: The photometer head shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. a diffusing window in front of the sensitive surface.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Perform a spatial uniformity check of the photometer aperture. Pass if there is no perceptible variation, or if a diffuser is fitted.

text: The field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Inspect the setup for apertures or masking that restrict the field of view and the light spread.

text: Reflections from the floor and walls shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Inspect the test range and confirm baffles are present between the floor/walls and both the sample and the photometer.

text: The residual stray light, measured with the sample covered by an opaque matt black surface (or equivalent), shall be subtracted from the value measured on the retro-reflector.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric testing
test_case: Measure the reading with the sample covered by a black cover and subtract it from each RI reading. Verify the correction is applied in the report.

text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1. (Classes IIIA and IIIB), from an observation distance of 10 metres.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (illuminating surface shape behind outer lens)
test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector's illuminating surface from an observation distance of 10 m. Pass if the shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral-triangle shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

text: If the retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C as the heat resistance test procedure.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (moulded plastics, Class IA/IB) behind outer lens
test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry-atmosphere oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours; record temperature and duration.

text: After the 48-hour exposure at 65 °C, the moulded plastics retro-reflector sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (moulded plastics, Class IA/IB)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: after heat exposure, cool the sample for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C before examination; verify conditioning log.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, in particular its optical component
test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling; pass if no cracks are visible on the device or its optical component.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
applies_to: Retro-reflector, in particular its optical component
test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 1 heat test and cooling; pass if no appreciable distortion of the device or its optical component is visible.

text: The retro-reflector, being part of a lamp, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (behind outer lens of rear combination lamp)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: remove removable parts, immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C, top of illuminating surface 20 mm below water surface.

text: The water immersion test of the retro-reflector shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: repeat 10 min immersion at 50 °C ± 5 °C with device inverted, rear face under about 20 mm of water.

text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflector sample units shall be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1: immediately transfer to water at 25 °C ± 5 °C under the same immersion conditions (both orientations, 10 min).

text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / housing and seal of the retro-reflective optical unit
test_case: Visual inspection after Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1 immersion sequence; pass: no water visible on the reflecting surface.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: After immersion and light shaking, measure RI per para. 5.1.3.2.2.; pass: RI meets the requirement of para. 5.1.3.2.2.

text: If the retro-reflector is of Class IB or IIIB, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied as an alternative test procedure of resistance to water penetration.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (Class IB/IIIB, integrated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 paras 2 and 2.3: perform both the moisture (water spray) test and the dust exposure test on the sample device; record the manufacturer's request for the alternative procedure.

text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
applies_to: Housing, seal/gasket, drain openings of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.1: inspect the sample before the test; no drain holes or openings taped or plugged; any drain wicks fitted as in production.

text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp sample with retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.2: mount on the rotating platform (min. diameter 140 mm); nozzle at 45° ± 5° to vertical; precipitation 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min; verify rotation of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.

text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp (LED PCBs) grouped with the retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.3: energise all lamp functions at design voltage, cycle 5 min ON / 55 min OFF; log the cycles.

text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp sample with retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.4: verify a test duration of 12 h with 12 complete 5/55 min cycles.

text: After the water spray, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp sample with retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.5: 1 h drain period with cabinet door closed before evaluation.

text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be able to form by tapping or tilting the device.
applies_to: Housing interior, outer lens, seal/gasket
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6: visually inspect the interior for moisture accumulation, then tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

text: After the water spray test, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after drying the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6 and Annex 4 Part 1: dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure the RI and compare it with the initial RI and the applicable requirements.

text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
applies_to: Housing, seal/gasket, drain openings of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.5: inspect the sample before the test; openings not sealed; drain wicks fitted as in production.

text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall, and the test dust shall be agitated by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, with the dust allowed to settle between agitation periods.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp sample with retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.6: cubical chamber 0.9 to 1.5 m per side, max. 2 m3, charged with 3 to 5 kg of ASTM C 150-84 cement dust; record device position (≥150 mm from walls) and the agitation schedule (2-15 s every 15 min for 5 h).

text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth, and the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.7 and para. 5.1.3.2.2: clean and dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure the RI and compare it with the initial RI and the applicable requirements.

text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 (ISO 9227:2017 saline mist); verify photometric and colorimetric characteristics after test remain within prescribed limits.

text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflector to tarnishing and of the protection of its rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (front surface, rear face protection, metal components)
test_case: Saline mist corrosion test per ISO 9227:2017; inspect front surface for tarnishing and rear face protection for deterioration.

text: Since the retro-reflector is combined with a lamp, the rear combination lamp shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp incorporating retro-reflector
test_case: Remove all removable parts; expose to saline mist 24 h, dry 2 h, expose 24 h (total 50 h); sample must complete test cycle for subsequent evaluation.

text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
applies_to: Retro-reflector with essential metal components
test_case: Verify test chamber: atomization at 35 °C ± 2 °C, 5 % NaCl by weight in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities, per ISO 9227:2017.

text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection immediately after 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion liable to impair efficiency.

text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (retro-reflective areas)
test_case: After corrosion test and 48 h recovery, clean salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (retro-reflective areas)
test_case: After corrosion test and 48 h recovery, clean salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface of the retro-reflector shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (front surface)
test_case: Verify cleaning of salt deposits from the retro-reflector surface prior to RA measurement.

text: If the retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (accessible mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5: brush the reverse side with a hard nylon brush as the first step of the rear-face resistance test; check that the step is completed before solvent exposure.

text: If the retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, after brushing, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the rear face of the retro-reflective device for one minute, after which the cloth is removed and the device left to dry.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (accessible mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5 para. 3: apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the brushed rear face for 1 min, remove it and let the device dry; record the exposure time and the mixture used.

text: If the retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, as soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed again with the same hard nylon brush as before.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (accessible mirror-backed rear face)
test_case: Annex 6 Part 5 para. 5: after the solvent has fully evaporated, re-brush the rear face with the same brush; check that the same brush was used.

text: If the retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, after the rear-face resistance test, the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face shall be covered with Indian ink and the CIL (RI) shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of the Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector photometric performance after rear-face test
test_case: Cover the entire mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink, then measure the CIL according to para. 5.1.3.2.2.; values shall comply with the photometric requirements for the class.

text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens covering the retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1: wipe the outer surface, especially the illuminating surface, lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in 70 vol.% n-heptane / 30 vol.% toluol. Pass: the test is carried out as specified.

text: About five minutes after wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens covering the retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): visual inspection about 5 min after the fuel wipe. Pass: no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

text: For a moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; outer lens over the retro-reflector (illuminating surface)
test_case: Annex 7 Part 2, para. 1.1: lightly wipe the outer surface, especially the illuminating surface, with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil. Pass: the oil is applied to the whole illuminating surface as prescribed.

text: For a moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; outer lens over the retro-reflector
test_case: Annex 7 Part 2, para. 1.1: after about 5 min of oil exposure, clean the surface. Pass: the surface is free of oil residue before the photometric measurement.

text: For a moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test, the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (retro-reflection function)
test_case: Annex 7 Part 2, para. 1.1: after the oil exposure and cleaning, measure RI per para. 5.1.3.2.2. Pass: the RI values meet the requirements of para. 5.1.3.2.2.

text: The approval mark of the retro-reflective device shall be arranged in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements shown in Annex 10 (Figures A10-I and A10-II) are examples only.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the lamp and of the marking drawing against paragraph 3.3. and the Annex 10 examples; pass if all elements required by paragraph 3.3. are present and arranged accordingly.

text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark on the device; pass if the approval number is located adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device shall face the same way as the "E".
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark; pass if the approval number digits have the same orientation as the letter "E".

text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
applies_to: Retro-reflector approval marking (class symbol, e.g. IA)
test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark; pass if the class symbol is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

text: Where the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector form part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the approval marking shall be arranged as a common marking for the unit, as in the variants of Models D and E of Figure A10-II, or another arrangement in accordance with paragraph 3.3.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp approval marking (outer lens / housing)
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the combination lamp against Figure A10-II Models D/E and paragraph 3.3.; pass if the identifiers of all functions in the unit are shown in a compliant arrangement.

text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) shall be so fitted on the vehicle that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of UN R48.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle (housing, fasteners/clips, seal/gasket, all lamp functions and retro-reflector)
test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle or a representative body fixture with production fasteners; perform vibration exposure representative of normal conditions of use (paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.); afterwards verify mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility and photometric/colour characteristics remain within R48 and component Regulation requirements; pass if no loosening, displacement or loss of compliance.

text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
applies_to: Mounting interface of the rear combination lamp (housing attachment points, fasteners/clips, locating features)
test_case: Design review and physical inspection of the mounting: verify positive locating features (pins/clips/fixed fasteners) define a unique installed position and orientation with no free adjustment; apply handling loads and vibration and confirm no change in aim/orientation; pass if lamp cannot be shifted out of its prescribed position without deliberate tool use.

text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector) on the vehicle
test_case: Installation inspection: with the vehicle on a flat horizontal surface, measure the angle of each function's reference axis relative to the bearing plane; pass if it is parallel within ±3°.

text: For signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) on the vehicle
test_case: Installation inspection: measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane in plan view; pass if it is parallel within ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with when the lamp is fitted to the vehicle.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle (housing, fasteners/clips, seal)
test_case: Review the manufacturer's fitting instructions and verify by inspection that the installed lamp conforms to them; pass if all instructions are met.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the M1 vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector)
test_case: Place the vehicle unladen on a flat, horizontal surface in the condition of paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.; measure the mounting height and orientation of each lamp function and the retro-reflector. Pass if the values meet the installation requirements for each function.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors on the left- and right-hand side) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this estimate is to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
applies_to: Installation of left- and right-hand rear combination lamp units (housing / outer lens exterior form)
test_case: Measure the installed positions of the left and right units on the vehicle against the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of the lamps; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
applies_to: Handed left/right rear combination lamp units (housing, outer lens, external shape)
test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left-hand and mirrored right-hand units (drawings/CAD and physical samples); pass if the units are mirror-symmetrical externally, interior structure excluded.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair (left and right rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector and outer lens colour of both handed units
test_case: Measure the colour of emitted/reflected light of each function on left and right units per the applicable colorimetric method; pass if both units meet the same colorimetric requirements for each function.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector photometry of left and right units
test_case: Perform photometric measurements of each function on left and right units at the prescribed test points; pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical (unless approved as a matched pair).

text: In case of rear lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Outer lens / lamp design if a manufacturer logo is incorporated; vehicle rear installation
test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear with lamps installed; pass if there are no logos in lamps, or only one lateral logo on each side, or only one central logo.

text: Logos incorporated in the rear combination lamp that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
applies_to: Outer lens / lamp graphics
test_case: Visual inspection of the lamp; pass if any logo incorporated is exclusively a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements for the paired rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) set out in the preceding paragraphs shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
applies_to: Installation of the handed left/right rear combination lamp pair on the M1 vehicle body
test_case: Inspect the vehicle drawings and the installed vehicle. Measure the lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane, and compare their mounting heights, colours and photometric characteristics. Pass if any deviation from the paired-lamp requirements is limited to what the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape makes unavoidable.

text: When the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled for each function.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (all functions: rear position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector)
test_case: Installation and conformity review of the lamp on the M1 vehicle against the individual requirements of each function (colour, mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility angles, electrical connection). Pass: every function meets its own requirements while grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated.

text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp; LED light sources; outer lens
test_case: Photometric measurement of each function individually with all other functions of the module switched OFF. Pass: luminous intensities meet the values prescribed for that function.

text: The colorimetric requirements of each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp; outer lens; reversing lamp window/insert
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function individually with all other functions switched OFF. Pass: chromaticity coordinates within the prescribed colour limits (red for rear position and stop, white for reversing).

text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with stop lamp (shared LED array / outer lens)
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (and any other reciprocally incorporated function) with the rear position lamp simultaneously switched ON. Pass: colour of each such function remains within its prescribed colour limits.

text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, it shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp apparent surfaces (3 x 8 LED reflector cup array, row of small LED elements); reversing lamp; outer lens
test_case: Geometric evaluation (CAD projection or measurement) of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the outer lens. Pass: projected area of distinct parts ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or minimum gap between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.; two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp housing and common outer lens with multiple apparent surfaces
test_case: Review of lamp classification and geometric evaluation per paragraph 5.7.2.1. (60 % area or 75 mm gap criterion). Pass: criterion met and the lamp is not declared/approved as an interdependent lamp system on the basis of separate surfaces in a common housing/outer lens.

text: The maximum height above the ground of each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on vehicle: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector
test_case: With the M1 vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, measure the vertical distance from the ground to the highest point of each function's apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: the value is obtained this way and is within the maximum height limit for that function.

text: The minimum height above the ground of each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on vehicle: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector
test_case: With the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, measure the vertical distance from the ground to the lowest point of each function's apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: the value is obtained this way and is at or above the minimum height limit for that function. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clearly met.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of the lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation height (where reduced geometric visibility angles are applied)
test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are claimed because of mounting height, measure the height of the horizontal plane containing the centre of reference (H plane) of the lamp above the ground. Pass: the reduction is justified by the H-plane height.

text: The position of the lamp as regards width, when referred to the overall width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp lateral position on vehicle (outboard corner)
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost edge of each function's apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis to the vehicle's overall-width limit plane. Pass: the value meets the applicable width requirement. Exact edges need not be determined where compliance is clearly met.

text: The position of the lamp as regards width, when referred to the distance between lamps, shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp pair (left/right handed units) lateral separation
test_case: Measure the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces, in the direction of the reference axis, of the left and right units for each function. Pass: the value meets the applicable minimum separation requirement.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (LED sources, PCB driver, outer lens)
test_case: With the rear position lamp switched ON at the test voltage, measure luminous intensity at reference points, chromaticity and apparent surface over time. Pass if there is no intentional variation (no modulation, flashing, dimming or sequential pattern) except variations permitted under paragraph 5.9.2.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Stop lamp (LED sources, PCB driver, outer lens)
test_case: With the stop lamp continuously activated, record intensity, colour and lit apparent surface over time. Pass if they stay steady with no intentional variation. Emergency stop signal flashing is only permitted where specifically allowed by paragraph 6.23 of UN R48.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (LED source, reversing reflector, reversing window in outer lens)
test_case: With the reversing lamp switched ON, monitor intensity, chromaticity (white) and apparent surface over time. Pass if there is no intentional variation, such as flashing, dimming or a sequential pattern.

text: If the photometric characteristics of the rear position lamp, stop lamp or reversing lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions, including the combined rear position/stop operation
test_case: For each variation state the design provides, measure photometry and colour against the applicable device regulation. States include day/night ambient levels and the rear position lamp with the stop lamp ON and OFF. Pass if every state meets the intensity, colour and apparent surface requirements of the lamp concerned.

text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, retro-reflector (red functions) as installed on the vehicle
test_case: Vehicle-level check according to paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, Annex 4). Pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
applies_to: Red rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector apparent surfaces; installation at vehicle rear outboard corner
test_case: Geometric or visual check on the vehicle per Annex 4: observer moved throughout Zone 1 in the transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle. Pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement of no direct visibility of red light towards the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
applies_to: Red rear position lamp and stop lamp (forward-emitted red light), including vehicle body influence
test_case: Photometric measurement of red light emitted towards the front from the type-approved lamp, considering the vehicle body shading if applicable. Pass if luminous intensity ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamp is switched ON and OFF only simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps (if they exist), the side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp, except while one or more of the conditions of paragraph 5.11.1 exist (position lamps switched ON as parking lamps; side-marker lamps flashing with direction indicators; daytime running lamps switched ON; front position lamp function substituted under paragraph 5.12.1).
applies_to: Rear position lamp; electrical connector / vehicle harness interface
test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch circuit: operate the position lamp switch and verify that the rear position lamps, front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps, side-marker lamps (if fitted) and rear registration plate lamp all turn ON and OFF together. Repeat with parking lamps, DRL and paragraph 5.12.1 substitution active to confirm only the permitted exceptions occur. Pass: no state in which any of these lamps can be switched ON or OFF independently outside the 5.11.1 exceptions.

text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the interdependent lamp system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; stop lamp; LED light sources / PCB wiring
test_case: Functional check of the interdependent lamp system: activate and deactivate the function and observe all LED light sources of all interdependent lamps. Pass: all light sources switch ON and OFF simultaneously with no independent operation.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Rear position lamp function (LED sources, outer lens colour definition)
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the rear position lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (LED sources, outer lens colour definition)
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the stop lamp light with the lamp operating at its rated voltage/current; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
applies_to: Reversing lamp function (light source, reversing window/insert in outer lens)
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates (x,y) of the reversing lamp light; pass if within the white area bounded by y = 0.150 + 0.640 x, y = 0.440, x = 0.500, y = 0.382, y = 0.050 + 0.750 x and x = 0.310.

text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
applies_to: Retro-reflector behind the outer lens
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the retro-reflected light under the standard illuminant according to the retro-reflector colour test procedure; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

text: The number of rear position lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (installation on vehicle, left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear position lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear position lamps (para. 6.10.2); pass if equal.

text: The number of stop lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp (installation on vehicle, left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count stop lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for stop lamps (para. 6.7.2); pass if equal.

text: The number of reversing lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (installation on vehicle)
test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count reversing lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for reversing lamps (para. 6.4.2); pass if equal.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation on vehicle, left and right rear combination lamps)
test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear non-triangular retro-reflectors fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear retro-reflectors (para. 6.14.2); pass if equal.

text: If the rear position lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (installation on vehicle, only if mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid)
test_case: Installation check on M1 vehicle: with the movable component placed in each fixed position (closed and every fixed open position), verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and photometric values per R48 / device approval. Pass if all requirements are met in every fixed position.

text: If the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, it shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors at all fixed positions of the movable component.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation on vehicle, only if mounted on a movable component)
test_case: Installation check on M1 vehicle: in each fixed position of the movable component, verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and retro-reflective performance. Pass if all requirements are met in every fixed position.

text: Where the rear position lamp is on a movable component and additional rear position lamps are fitted and switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the rear position lamps installed on the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (vehicle installation with movable component and additional lamps)
test_case: With the movable component in each fixed open position, verify the additional lamps are switched ON and measure their position, geometric visibility and photometric performance. Pass if they meet the requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (installation on vehicle, near movable components such as tailgate/boot lid)
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position (locked or not) other than the normal position of use; determine the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis that remains unobscured. Pass: no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface hidden.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation on vehicle, near movable components)
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use; determine the unobscured apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of the reference axis. Pass: no more than 50 per cent hidden.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (alternative installation solution, vehicle electrical control)
test_case: Move the movable component to each fixed position where more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify by inspection/measurement that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps. Pass: additional lamps ON and compliant.

text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp and additional lamps are not provided, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements; this alternative does not apply to retro-reflectors (paragraph 5.21.3).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (vehicle installation alternative; user notice)
test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the presence of the user notice describing the positions of movable components in which more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden and the need to warn other road users. Pass: notice present; verify retro-reflector compliance is achieved by paragraph 5.21 or 5.21.1 and not by this notice.

text: The rear position lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the rear position lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (LED light sources, PCB, wiring and connector to vehicle harness)
test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted (no additional wiring, modules or modifications), switch on the rear position lamp function; pass if the lamp operates.

text: The stop lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the stop lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
applies_to: Stop lamp (LED light sources, PCB, wiring and connector to vehicle harness)
test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, apply the service brake; pass if the stop lamp operates without any further installation work.

text: The reversing lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the reversing lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (light source in reversing compartment, wiring and connector to vehicle harness)
test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted, engage reverse gear with the ignition on; pass if the reversing lamp operates without any further installation work.

text: If the rear combination lamp is approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37 (e.g. a replaceable bulb in the reversing compartment), except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., the lamp shall be fitted in the vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
applies_to: Installation of the rear combination lamp on the vehicle; any UN R37 replaceable light source (e.g. reversing lamp light source), housing, fasteners/clips, seal
test_case: Check whether any light source is a UN R37 replaceable light source. If yes, perform a replacement trial on the vehicle using only the tools supplied with the vehicle and the manufacturer's procedure, without expert assistance; pass if the light source is removed and correctly reinstalled, seated and functioning. N/A for LED light sources that are non-replaceable per 2.9.1.2.

text: If the rear combination lamp is approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37 not used as non-replaceable light sources, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source.
applies_to: Vehicle documentation for the rear combination lamp's UN R37 replaceable light source(s)
test_case: Document review: verify the owner's manual/vehicle documentation contains a detailed step-by-step replacement procedure for the lamp's R37 light source(s); pass if present and sufficient to perform the replacement trial.

text: Where a light source module of the rear combination lamp includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23., i.e. correctly replaceable without expert assistance and without special tools other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
applies_to: Light source module (LED PCB module) containing an R37 light source holder, e.g. reversing lamp round light-source element
test_case: Inspect module design for any R37 holder; if present, perform replacement trial on the vehicle with only vehicle-supplied tools following the manufacturer's procedure; pass if the R37 light source is replaced correctly without expert assistance or special tools.

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function)
test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; verify replacement function emits red light within the rear position lamp colour boundaries (R48 / R148 colorimetric requirements). Pass: colour similar (red).

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function)
test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; photometric measurement of replacement function at H-V and key points. Pass: main intensity similar to the original rear position lamp values.

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in position to the function that has ceased to operate.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (fail-safe replacement function)
test_case: Simulate failure; inspect/measure position of the replacement light-emitting surface on the vehicle. Pass: position similar to the original rear position lamp (installation dimensions per R48).

text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
applies_to: Replacement device (e.g. stop lamp function) during rear position lamp fail-safe operation
test_case: With replacement active, actuate the replacement device's original function (e.g. braking). Pass: original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
applies_to: Vehicle failure detection / dashboard tell-tale for rear position lamp
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with replacement active. Pass: dashboard tell-tale illuminates indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, they shall respond simultaneously only to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (variable intensity control, if fitted)
test_case: Review the control strategy and inputs, then trigger each listed environmental and traffic condition. Pass if both lamps respond simultaneously and only to the conditions in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, their intensities shall all vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (combined/reciprocally incorporated in rear combination lamp)
test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of both functions at several control levels across the full range. Pass if both vary together in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range, including throughout variation transitions.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (intensity ratio)
test_case: Measure the intensities of both lamps simultaneously, at the same measurement point, at steady levels and during transitions across the whole range. Pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is met at every point.

text: When the luminous intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp is increased or decreased in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface, the intensity shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (environmental intensity adaptation)
test_case: Simulate each environmental condition and measure photometry at the minimum and maximum adapted levels. Pass if all values stay within the minimum and maximum limits of the pertinent device regulation (e.g. UN R7 / R148).

text: A decrease of the luminous intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp due to traffic conditions shall only be activated when the vehicle speed is equal to or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal to or less than 20 m.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (traffic-based dimming control)
test_case: Run a vehicle or HIL test that varies speed and following distance. Pass if dimming activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m.

text: An activated traffic-condition decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp or stop lamp shall not remain active once the vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h, unless the activation conditions of paragraph 5.26.2. (speed ≤ 20 km/h or distance to following vehicle ≤ 20 m) are again fulfilled.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (traffic-based dimming control)
test_case: Activate dimming, then accelerate above 50 km/h with the following distance > 20 m. Pass if the intensity returns to the non-reduced level.

text: A decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp or stop lamp due to traffic conditions shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (traffic-based dimming level)
test_case: Measure photometry in the reduced-intensity state. Pass if the values are not below the minimum limits of the pertinent device regulation.

text: No sharp variation of intensity of the variable-intensity rear position lamp or stop lamp shall be observed during transition.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (intensity transitions)
test_case: Record intensity over time with a photodetector during each up and down transition, together with visual observation. Pass if there are no abrupt steps or flicker and the change is gradual.

text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, and if the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) has, according to its type approval documentation, been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the lamp shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as it has been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electrical supply / connector terminals (rear position, stop, reversing functions) as installed on M1 vehicle
test_case: On the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the lamp terminals for each function; pass if the voltage does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 6 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electrical supply / terminals on 6 V vehicle system
test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 per cent.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 12 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electrical supply / terminals on 12 V vehicle system
test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 13.5 V + 3 per cent.

text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 24 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electrical supply / terminals on 24 V vehicle system
test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 28 V + 3 per cent.

text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Outer lens; vehicle installation (rear outboard corner)
test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection: observe the apparent surface from infinity (or parallel-shifted directions) over the full geometric visibility angles prescribed for the rear position lamp; pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the stop lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
applies_to: Stop lamp; Outer lens; vehicle installation
test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the stop lamp geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the reversing lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
applies_to: Reversing lamp; Reversing lamp window/insert in outer lens; vehicle installation
test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the reversing lamp geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the retro-reflector to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the device was type-approved are not taken into account.
applies_to: Retro-reflector; Outer lens; vehicle installation
test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection over the rear retro-reflector geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstruction of any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at type approval.

text: If geometric visibility measurements are taken closer to the lamp than infinity, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
applies_to: All lamp functions and retro-reflector; geometric visibility verification
test_case: Review of measurement setup: for near-field checks, verify observation directions are parallel-shifted so that each point of the apparent surface is checked along the prescribed angle; pass if accuracy equivalent to observation from infinity.

text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of a lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp; Retro-reflector; vehicle installation
test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed (partially masked) unit or with representative masking; pass if the unmasked part meets all photometric values prescribed for approval of each function.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Reversing lamp; Retro-reflector; mounting height
test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1.; if below 750 mm and reduction to 5° is applicable, verify photometry of installed unit over field down to 5° below horizontal; pass if prescribed values met in that reduced field.

text: If an LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) is not replaceable, this shall be stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED module shall be replaceable.
applies_to: LED modules / LED light sources on PCB(s) for the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Document and design review: compare the replaceability of each LED module in the lamp (removal without destroying the lamp) against the component type approval communication sheet (UN R7/R23 or R148). Pass if each non-replaceable LED module is declared non-replaceable on the communication sheet, or if the module is replaceable.

text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear position lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp
test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for rear position lamp, category R/R1/R2) is held and marked on the lamp before vehicle installation; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

text: When installed on a vehicle, the stop lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp
test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for stop lamp, category S1/S2) is held and marked on the lamp; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

text: When installed on a vehicle, the reversing lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
applies_to: Reversing lamp
test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for reversing lamp, AR) is held and marked on the lamp; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.
