text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R150 approval mark for rear retro-reflector, class IA or IB) is held and marked on the device; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; stop lamp; outer lens (if a manufacturer logo is incorporated)
test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo in the light-emitting surface; if present, verify the UN R148 approval covers the logo configuration; pass if approval to UN R148 including the logo exists.

text: A reversing lamp shall be mandatorily installed on motor vehicles (including category M1).
applies_to: Reversing lamp – installation on M1 vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp function is fitted; pass if present.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – number of devices on M1 vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – component type approval
test_case: Document and marking check: verify valid R23 (00 or later series) or R148 (00 or later series) approval and approval marking on the lamp for the reversing function.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – mounting height on vehicle
test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per R48 procedures; pass if lowest point ≥ 250 mm and highest point ≤ 1,200 mm.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – longitudinal position on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – vertical geometric visibility
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down relative to reference axis; pass if visible throughout.

text: If there is only one reversing lamp device installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° to the right and to the left.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – horizontal geometric visibility (single device)
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7 on vehicle with one reversing lamp: verify visibility over 45° right and 45° left; pass if visible throughout.

text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – horizontal geometric visibility (two devices, handed units)
test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7 for each of the two lamps: verify visibility over 45° outwards and 30° inwards; pass if visible throughout.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / activation logic
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse gear with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / deactivation logic
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion control to off; also attempt activation with either condition unmet; pass if lamp is OFF in all cases.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – failure tell-tale / electronics
test_case: Check R23/R148 requirements for failure indication; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale operates.

text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 shall be installed on the M1 category vehicle (mandatory).
applies_to: Stop lamp (S1/S2 category, rear combination lamp)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp (left- and right-hand rear combination lamps)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps, handed unit plus mirrored opposite-side unit. Pass if exactly two are installed.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Stop lamp function of rear combination lamp
test_case: Check the approval marking on the lamp and the approval certificate. Pass if the approval is to UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series.

text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of an S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp position in width (vehicle installation)
test_case: Measure on the vehicle, according to R48 para. 5.8 methods, the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Stop lamp mounting height (vehicle installation)
test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground with the vehicle unladen, per para. 5.8.1. Pass if the lowest edge is ≥ 350 mm and the highest edge is ≤ 1,500 mm, or ≤ 2,100 mm where the bodywork justifies it.

text: The horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be below the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of the S3 or S4 category device.
applies_to: Stop lamp height relative to the high-mounted stop lamp (vehicle installation)
test_case: On the vehicle, measure the height of the upper edge of the S1/S2 apparent surface and the height of the lower edge of the S3/S4 apparent surface. Pass if the S3/S4 lower edge is higher.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp position in length (vehicle installation)
test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation. Pass if the lamp is mounted at the vehicle rear.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp geometric visibility (horizontal)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle per R48 para. 2.13 and 5.10. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° outward and 45° inward, or 20° inward under the H plane where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Stop lamp geometric visibility (vertical)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed 15° up and 15° down, or 5° down where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp orientation
test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction on the vehicle. Pass if it points rearward.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
applies_to: Stop lamp electrical connection / LED drive circuit
test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: apply the brake signal and observe all stop lamps, including the S3/S4 lamp. Pass if all illuminate simultaneously.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp failure monitoring / vehicle tell-tale
test_case: Check the component regulation (R7/R148) requirements. If a failure tell-tale is required, simulate an LED failure and verify the tell-tale activates.

text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – installation on M1 vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the rear combination lamp contains a rear position lamp function approved as category R, R1 or R2 (approval marking check). Pass if present on the vehicle.

text: Two rear position lamps shall be installed on the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – left and right (handed) rear combination lamps
test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps fitted (left-hand unit and mirrored right-hand unit). Pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are installed.

text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – type approval / approval marking
test_case: Document and marking check: verify the approval mark on the lamp references UN R7 02 or later series, or UN R148 00 or later series. Pass if a valid approval exists.

text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – lateral mounting position on vehicle
test_case: Installation measurement on the vehicle: measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (in the direction of the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Rear position lamp – mounting height on vehicle
test_case: Installation measurement with vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, measured according to paragraph 5.8.1: pass if the height is ≥ 350 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape makes 1,500 mm impossible and no optional lamps are fitted).

text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – longitudinal mounting position
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear combination lamp with the rear position lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if located at the vehicle rear.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – horizontal geometric visibility (housing, outer lens, body cut-outs)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards (inward angle 20° under the H plane permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – vertical geometric visibility
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – alternative horizontal geometric visibility (M1 with rear side-marker lamp)
test_case: If the alternative is chosen, verify that a rear side-marker lamp is installed and that the apparent surface is visible over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if both conditions are met.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – alternative vertical geometric visibility
test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify view of the apparent surface 15° above and below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if met.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – apparent surface vs. integrated retro-reflector and outer lens
test_case: At each direction within the alternative visibility angles, determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp, subtracting non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area. Pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² in every direction.

text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards as installed. Pass if oriented rearwards.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory, except when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – vehicle tell-tale
test_case: Vehicle function test: switch on rear position lamps with DRL off and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates. Pass if tell-tale indicates switching ON.

text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – vehicle tell-tale
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify a single combined tell-tale operates for front and rear position lamps. Pass if combined.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp – failure tell-tale (LED light source failure)
test_case: Check component Regulation (UN R7/R148) approval conditions; if failure indication required, simulate LED/light source failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates. Pass if activated.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (vehicle installation)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify a non-triangular rear retro-reflector is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (handed pair, left and right units)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count mandatory rear non-triangular retro-reflectors (one per handed unit); pass if exactly two mandatory devices.

text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
applies_to: Retro-reflector
test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate of the retro-reflector: pass if Class IA or IB per UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / additional retro-reflecting materials in rear lamp
test_case: Visual and photometric assessment on the vehicle: pass if any additional retro-reflecting device or material does not impair the mandatory rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions.

text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation position)
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation height)
test_case: Measure on the vehicle (unladen, ground substantially horizontal) the height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation height)
test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps in the combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm with bodywork-shape justification.

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be situated at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (installation position)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens and housing (geometric visibility)
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle or CAD: verify the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards; pass if visible throughout.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Retro-reflector / outer lens and housing (geometric visibility)
test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify unobstructed visibility 10° upwards and 10° downwards (5° downwards if mounting height < 750 mm per para. 5.8.1.); pass if visible throughout.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Retro-reflector (orientation)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards; pass if rearward facing.

text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to UN R48 shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R48, including the installation of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector, housing and mounting)
test_case: Conformity of production check: on series-production vehicles, verify that the rear combination lamp installation (number, position, geometric visibility, orientation, electrical connections and tell-tales) meets the requirements of R48 paragraphs 5. and 6. as for the approved type; pass if no deviation from the approved type is found.

text: The position of the rear combination lamp functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector), as defined in paragraph 2.1.6., in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Installation of rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector on the M1 vehicle
test_case: Conformity of production check on the vehicle: measure width, height and length positions of each lamp per paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if measured positions comply.

text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Installation of rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector on the M1 vehicle
test_case: Compare measured mounting distances against the individual installation specifications for each lamp function; pass if all limits are met.

text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Geometric visibility of the rear combination lamp functions as installed
test_case: Measure angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 2.10.7. on the vehicle; pass if the individual angle specifications for each lamp are met within an allowance of ±3º.

text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp and stop lamp towards the front shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp (red light) as installed
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that red light is not directly visible from the front zone defined; pass if requirements of 5.10. are met.

text: The visibility of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (white light) and outer lens as installed
test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that white light visible towards the rear is only from permitted lamps (reversing lamp); pass if requirements of 5.10. are met.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
applies_to: Electrical connector, wiring and LED light sources of rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Switch on each lamp function via the vehicle electrical system; pass if each function lights.

text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their associated tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp switching and tell-tales
test_case: Functional check of switching conditions and tell-tales against paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications; pass if all conform.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp functions, outer lens colour and approval markings
test_case: Visual inspection of installed lamps and markings; pass if presence, number, colour (red for rear position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing), arrangement and category comply with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications.

text: Red light from the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall not be directly visible to the eye of an observer moving within zone 1, in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.). Zone 1 is bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Outer lens; Housing (installed on M1 vehicle)
test_case: Visibility check per Annex 4 with the lamp installed on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Explore zone 1 in front of the vehicle between eye heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp, including its illuminated surface or reflections, is directly visible from any point in the zone.

text: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes. Each plane forms an angle of 15° outwards to the front from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. Each plane passes through the point of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width. If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp; Stop lamp; Outer lens; Housing (installed position at rear outboard corner)
test_case: Geometric or CAD sightline analysis per Annex 4. Construct 15° outward vertical planes through the foremost overall-width contact points and, from the zone 1 envelope (1 m to 2.2 m height) bounded by these planes, check sightlines to the lamp's red light-emitting surfaces. Pass if no red light-emitting surface is directly visible.
